name: amar-plastik-pos
description: Sistem Kasir (POS), Inventaris, & Analitik Retail Toko Bahan Kue dan Perlengkapan Plastik Amar Plastik

scripts.dev: node -e "const http=require('http'), fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); const server=http.createServer((req,res)=>{ let p=path.join(__dirname, req.url.split('?')[0]); if(req.url==='/') p=path.join(__dirname, 'index.html'); if(fs.existsSync(p) && fs.statSync(p).isFile()){ const ext=path.extname(p); const ct={'.html':'text/html','.js':'application/javascript','.css':'text/css','.png':'image/png','.jpg':'image/jpeg','.svg':'image/svg+xml'}[ext]||'text/plain'; res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':ct}); fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res); } else { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not Found'); } }); const PORT=process.env.PORT||4321; server.listen(PORT, ()=>console.log('POS Server berjalan di http://localhost:'+PORT));"

author: Amar Plastik
